Kuvitus: hämärässä pajassa ahjon hiillos: Illustration: in a dim smithy the embers of a forge glow. A long iron bar extends from the forge towards an anvil on the right. The hot end of the bar in the embers is almost white, and further away the bar glows yellow, orange and red, until the cold end on the anvil is dark grey. Heat shimmers above the hot part of the bar.
Periaatekuva sähkömagneettisesta aallost: Schematic figure of an electromagnetic wave at one instant, not to scale. The wave travels from left to right along a horizontal axis. The brown electric field E oscillates in the vertical direction and the green magnetic field B in a horizontal plane drawn obliquely, perpendicular both to the electric field and to the direction of travel. The fields are in phase: they are greatest and zero at the same points. The distance between two successive peaks of the electric field is the wavelength lambda. The wave travels at the speed c.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: pystysuo: Schematic figure, not to scale: a vertical rod antenna whose two metal rods are connected at the middle to an alternating-voltage source. A violet arrow beside the rods shows that at this instant the current flows upwards; half a period later it flows downwards. Arcs leave the antenna towards the right, representing the crests of the travelling wave. Brown arrows on the horizontal axis show the electric field, which is parallel to the antenna and changes direction every half wavelength. The distance between two crests in the same direction is the wavelength lambda.
Kaavakuva sähkömagneettisesta spektristä: Schematic figure of the electromagnetic spectrum. A horizontal bar with a logarithmic wavelength scale: each scale interval is a factor of a thousand in wavelength. From left to right: radio waves (over 1 m), microwaves (1 mm–1 m), infrared radiation (750 nm–1 mm), a narrow band of visible light, ultraviolet radiation (10–380 nm), X-rays (0.01–10 nm) and gamma rays (under about 0.01 nm). The band of visible light is enlarged below the bar: red at about 750 nm on the left and violet at about 380 nm on the right.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: mustan kappaleen: Graph to scale: the spectrum of black-body radiation at three temperatures. The horizontal axis shows the wavelength in nanometres from zero to 2000, the vertical axis the radiated power per unit area and wavelength interval in megawatts per square metre and micrometre. The region of visible light, 380–750 nm, is a colour band in the background. The solid black curve is 6000 K, the dashed orange line 5000 K and the dotted red line 4000 K. The peaks are at the wavelengths 483 nm, 580 nm and 724 nm, and their heights are about 100, 40 and 13. The hotter the body, the higher the curve and the shorter the wavelength of the peak.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: hehkuvan kappalee: Graph to scale: the spectrum of the radiation from a glowing body. The horizontal axis shows the wavelength in micrometres from zero to four, with a grid spacing of 0.2 µm; the vertical axis shows the radiated power per unit area and wavelength interval in megawatts per square metre and micrometre, with a grid spacing of 0.2. The curve rises steeply from about 0.4 µm, reaches its peak, whose height is about 1.06, and then falls gently. The region of visible light, 0.38–0.75 µm, is marked with a colour band next to the horizontal axis.
